title: Agenda always visible
description: During the agenda phase the agenda stays on screen: a one-line strip under the top bar ('Agenda 1/2: name · For/Against or Elect · whose vote') that survives the vote dialog, minimizing, waiting states and resolution, and clears with the phase. Dialogs start below it and the strip opens on tap (printed text, outcomes, votes so far, speaker). The minimized pill names the agenda. Before shots use what the real engine sent (no agenda in the vote decisions, so nothing named it); after shots use the engine's new display-only details.agenda. Synthetic fixtures through a mocked server.

shots.heading: Before: agenda revealed, a reaction window (390x844)
shots.caption: The Sabotage window never says which agenda was revealed.

shots.heading: After: agenda revealed, a reaction window
shots.caption: Strip under the top bar: 'Agenda 1/2: Minister of Peace · Your reaction'. The agenda comes from the reaction trigger and is remembered for the phase.

shots.heading: Before: my vote, outcome choice (390x844)
shots.caption: The vote decisions name no agenda: the dialog only says 'vote for which outcome'.

shots.heading: After: my vote, outcome choice
shots.caption: The strip names the agenda, For/Against and whose vote; the vote dialog starts below it. (Needs the engine's display-only details.agenda.)

shots.heading: Before: spending influence, 8 planets (360x740)
shots.caption: Long planet list; nothing says what is being voted on.

shots.heading: After: spending influence, 8 planets
shots.caption: The strip stays put above the dialog while the list scrolls; the dialog is shortened to fit under it.

shots.heading: Before: rider prediction (390x844)
shots.caption: The prediction asks FOR or AGAINST without naming the agenda.

shots.heading: After: rider prediction
shots.caption: The decision carries no agenda, so the strip uses the phase's memory from the reveal: 'Your prediction'.

shots.heading: Before: another seat votes, I wait (390x844)
shots.caption: No agenda in view while waiting.

shots.heading: After: another seat votes, I wait
shots.caption: 'Agenda 1/2: Minister of Peace · For/Against · Player 2's vote'.

shots.heading: Before: speaker breaks the tie (390x844)
shots.caption: Tie-break dialog without the agenda.

shots.heading: After: speaker breaks the tie
shots.caption: 'You break the tie' with the agenda in the strip.

shots.heading: Before: Elect Player agenda (390x844)
shots.caption: Candidates only.

shots.heading: After: Elect Player agenda
shots.caption: The strip says 'Elect Player' instead of For/Against.

shots.heading: Before: landscape 844x390
shots.caption: Dialog only.

shots.heading: After: landscape 844x390
shots.caption: One-line strip; the dialog panel sits under it.

shots.heading: Before: dialog minimized to the pill
shots.caption: The pill says 'vote for which outcome'; the agenda is nowhere.

shots.heading: After: dialog minimized to the pill
shots.caption: The pill reads 'Voting: Minister of Peace — For/Against' and the strip stays above the free map.

shots.heading: Before: prediction minimized
shots.caption: The pill shows the raw prompt.

shots.heading: After: prediction minimized

shots.heading: Tap the strip
shots.caption: The printed text, outcomes, votes so far and the speaker open under the line; the strip grows and the dialog starts below it, so no vote control is covered.
